title: The Deeper Teachings of Jesus | How-to-Live Talk With Meditation

# The Deeper Teachings of Jesus: An SRF How-to-Live Talk

### Speaker • Brother Nikhilananda, Self-Realization Fellowship

### Introduction: The Universal Christ Consciousness

In our studies, as outlined by our Guru, Paramahansa Yogananda, we come to understand that the teachings of Jesus were not meant to be confined to a single sectarian dogma. Rather, they are a profound guide to the realization of the Christ Consciousness within. When we speak of the deeper teachings of Jesus, we are talking about the internal science of the soul—the path of Kriya Yoga that allows us to perceive the Father dwelling within the temple of our own being.

### The Kingdom Within

Jesus taught, 'The kingdom of God is within you.' This is not a metaphor. It is an experiential truth. We spend our lives searching for happiness in the outer world, in the shifting sands of material possession and egoic satisfaction. Yet, the peace we seek—the bliss of the Spirit—is already residing at the center of our own consciousness. Through the practice of stillness and meditation, we begin to peel back the layers of mental noise and subconscious conditioning.

**Story • The Lost Diamond**

Story: A man spent his entire life traveling the world searching for a legendary diamond, suffering through poverty, storms, and disappointment. He grew old and weary, finally returning to his humble childhood home. One day, while digging in his small backyard to plant seeds, his shovel struck a hard, glittering object. It was the very diamond he had sought his entire life, buried right beneath the soil of his own home. Like the man in the story, we travel through lifetimes searching for God, never realizing that the Divine Presence is buried beneath the layers of our own wandering mind, waiting to be unearthed by the spade of meditation.

### Practical Application: How to Live

To live the teachings of Jesus is to live a life of divine centeredness. Yogananda emphasized that we must be 'in the world, but not of it.' This does not mean running away from duties. On the contrary, it means performing every duty with the awareness that we are instruments of the Divine. When we sit in meditation, we draw the energy inward. When we go out into the world, we must keep a portion of that interiorized peace, even while engaging in work, service, and family life.

### The Scientific Technique of Meditation

1. **Stillness:** The first requirement is to command the body and the breath. As the breath becomes calm, the mind becomes calm.
2. **The Eye of Intuition:** Focus the attention at the Christ Center, the point between the eyebrows (the Kutastha Chaitanya).
3. **Devotion:** Meditation without love is like a field without water. Combine the technique with a deep, heart-felt yearning for the Divine.

### Conclusion: The Eternal Promise

Jesus promised, 'I will not leave you comfortless.' That promise remains true today. By following the path of Kriya Yoga and the teachings of the masters, we learn to commune with that eternal Christ Consciousness. Let us resolve to make every moment a meditation, bringing the kingdom of heaven down into our daily experience.
